title: Boba Fett's Starship
description: Boba Fett's starship, a uniquely designed Firespray-31-class was a powerful pursuit craft made famous by his father, Jango Fett. Inheriting the ship after his father's death at the hands of Mace Windu, Boba Fett's ship was equipped with a powerhouse of hidden defensive and offensive weaponry including seismic charges, laser cannons, and more. Boba Fett used the ship to transport cargo—such as the carbon-frozen body of Han Solo—as well as crew and allies like the Mandalorian.
